title: How Oliver and Armstrong met and why Oliver sent for him
summary: Rose thinks Oliver might have sent for Petit first but liked Louis personally; they met in the same band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Uh, is it true, is it true that he, that he was not, that when Oliver sent for him, he was not the first considered for the job? Like that?

Well, uh, I would have thought that, uh, that Oliver would have sent for Petit first. Right. See? That would have been the logical thing to do, so, but I don't know that, that he offered the job to anybody else. Right. Because he liked Louis personally. Yeah.
How did, how did, how did those two meet? How did Oliver and Louis?

And so they played together in the band and got to hear each other. Uh-huh. And of course, uh, as it turns out, they were both very much impressed. Uh-huh.
